architecture: role-owned authority broker; separate SQLite file per role/service instance; private state, head, journal and outcomes co-committed

roles.private_scope: issuer identities, operation correlations; no holder secret or attributes
roles.unavailable: affected role unavailable; no fallback empty state

roles.private_scope: attributes, evidence, controller binding, confidential result and channel identity
roles.unavailable: affected role unavailable; no fallback empty state

roles.durable_facts: every challenge reservation and consumed decision
roles.private_scope: audience/session policy and consumption; public statement/proof only
roles.unavailable: affected role unavailable; no fallback empty state

roles.durable_facts: ordered full chains, append outcomes and publication state
roles.private_scope: operator key access; no holder secret
roles.unavailable: affected role unavailable; no fallback empty state

roles.authoriser: resolver owner within its trust domain
roles.durable_facts: all reserved read nonces, configuration and recovery generation
roles.private_scope: query history/nonce associations; no hidden-DID verifier lookup
roles.unavailable: affected role unavailable; no fallback empty state

roles.unavailable: affected role unavailable; no fallback empty state

failure_model.rule: Durable role store survives; one complete transaction or none; fresh process reconciles unknown response.
Same non-rolled-back ext4 authority files and hot journals; truthful flush/VHD storage required.
No empty bootstrap or old backup admission; unavailable head/blob/outcome quarantines.
Exact authority head/ticket comparison rejects cache rollback.
A consistent older DB cannot detect its own rollback; external independent anchor needed.
Generation plus prior head/operation checks at every protected boundary.

failure_model.failure: power loss or faulty host flush
failure_model.rule: SQLite configuration is a prerequisite, not a verified WSL hardware guarantee.

failure_model.failure: malicious owner/root or raw DB bypass
failure_model.rule: Owner can bypass SQLite/application checks; OS isolation and trusted broker required.

atomicity.missing_checkpoint: quarantine, never fall back to older head

issuer_reconciliation.signing_without_committed_certificate: retire after authoritative check; no automatic signing retry
issuer_reconciliation.committed_certificate: original exact bytes only, separately authenticated redelivery; ordinary finish remains REPLAY
issuer_reconciliation.cross_role: durable issuer intent then idempotent manager reservation then issuer attachment; no rollback of orphan rid

next_pilot_scope: bounded SQLite core and recovery bridge
verifier register/consume for A and B
issuer private journal/reconciliation and exact-result retrieval

future_tests.label: new-process
future_tests.criterion: Kill before and after BEGIN/row writes/COMMIT; reopen from a distinct process; admit exactly old or complete new head.

future_tests.label: new-process
future_tests.criterion: Kill after successful COMMIT before response; retrieve exact durable outcome without duplicate transition.

future_tests.label: rollback-cache
future_tests.criterion: Restore an old service checkpoint with intact authority; reject even when signed root is identical.

future_tests.label: concurrent-processes
future_tests.criterion: Two processes compete for replacement from the same expected generation and, separately, different mutations from one expected head; at most one grant/first-head commit, bounded BUSY/conflict for the other.

future_tests.label: fencing
future_tests.criterion: Pause old writer, replace it, resume; allocation, consume, certification and signed publication fail old generation.

future_tests.label: idempotency
future_tests.criterion: Same operation ID/same complete contents recovers existing outcome; changed contents reject; verify never yields a second acceptance.

future_tests.label: issuer-coordination
future_tests.criterion: Kill around issuer intent, manager reserve and issuer attachment; resolve immutable operation mapping; never reuse or rebind rid.

future_tests.label: issuer-signing
future_tests.criterion: Interrupt SIGNING or deliver delayed signature after replacement; retire/quarantine without another signing call.

future_tests.label: issuer-certification
future_tests.criterion: Kill before/after certification commit and release; only committed exact result may be retrieved by the original authorised recipient.

future_tests.label: unavailable-incomplete
future_tests.criterion: Missing database/head/blob/outcome, digest disagreement, IO/FULL/BUSY and unavailable authority fail closed; no auto-empty or retry.

future_tests.label: original-controls
future_tests.criterion: Retain both original unsafe controls; recovered manager/verifier interfaces block the corresponding stale images.

future_tests.label: clock-private-scope
future_tests.criterion: Fresh clock at atomic consume rejects expiry; separate verifier stores and all role checkpoint contents remain isolated.

future_tests.label: resources
future_tests.criterion: 512 KiB file/page budget, 64 KiB pilot checkpoint, bounded SQL steps/waits; exhaustion does not advance head.

future_tests.label: local-overflow
future_tests.criterion: Generation/sequence at signed-63-bit maximum rejects replacement/commit without wrap.

future_tests.label: publication
future_tests.criterion: Delay signing then replace/advance state; publication owner rechecks generation and head before releasing bytes.

future_tests.label: lease-exit
future_tests.criterion: Fail activation COMMIT/context exit or return suppressed exception; facade cannot serve; durable unused grant may remain safely consumed.

unresolved: OS principal/key broker isolation and authorisation provisioning
